summary.text: Keith Allen is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 19A, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Allen's career experience includes working in farming and agriculture.

paragraphs.text: Keith Allen graduated from Dover-Eyota High School, earned an associate degree from Hawkeye Community College and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, in 2002.
His career experience includes working in the farming and agricultural industry.
Allen succeeded Brian Daniels in District 19A and was assigned to the Commerce Finance and Policy, Higher Education Finance and Policy, and Capital Investment committees for 2025 and 2026.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Allen described himself as a lifelong Minnesotan who has lived in his community for 22 years, and said he would continue to press for stronger oversight of state government, including an Independent Office of the Inspector General.
He also listed property tax and regulatory relief and support for law enforcement among his key messages.
